root_cause: Assuming sequential trajectory data (time-series) in decoupled frame pairs, leading to invalid temporal smoothing filters (EMA, SO(3) geodesic velocity dampening).

details.rule: Always verify if visual odometry / pose estimation datasets consist of continuous video streams or independent image pairs before applying temporal trajectory logic. Never apply motion priors, velocity decay, or EMA/geodesic smoothing to unconstrained or randomized pairwise test data.
